Faridabad woman arrested for allegedly murdering live-in partner

Police in Faridabad have arrested a woman named Anita from Madhya Pradesh for allegedly murdering her live-in partner, Sadakat Ali, from Uttar Pradesh. The accused reportedly gave the victim alcohol before slitting his throat. The victim's body was allegedly kept in a locked room for five days before being discovered. The motive for the murder is under investigation.
